title: Opentrons COVID-19 Testing Protocol for RT-qPCR
author: Max Marrone
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.beqajdse
materials: 500 µL, Endogenous Control Mix Well B
Wait for the run to finish.

steps.title: Prepare Reagent Tube Rack
steps.instruction: Prepare an Opentrons 24 tube rack with reagents from the BP Genomics 2019-nCoV Detection Assay kit according to kit instructions.

substeps.instruction: Place 1000 µL Reaction Mix in Well A1
Place 500 µL Endogenous Control Mix in Well B1
Place 50 µL nuclease-free water in Well B3
Place 50 µL standard curve dilution 4 (Positive Control Template diluted to 200 copies per µL) in Well D3

steps.title: Load Labware into Robot
steps.instruction: Load the required plates and racks into the specified Opentrons robot slots.

substeps.instruction: Slot 4: Place an empty, sterile qPCR plate on an Opentrons 96 well aluminum block atop the Temperature Module
Slot 5: Place the prepared reagent tube rack
Slot 3: Place a full, sterile Opentrons 20 µL filter tip rack

Slot 1: Place the elution plate (NEST 96 Well Plate 100 µL PCR Full Skirt) containing 27 samples from Station B starting at the top-left corner, water filling remaining wells up to 6 columns, and an extra sample in well H12

steps.title: Pre-cool Temperature Module
steps.instruction: Start pre-cooling the Temperature Module to 6 °C.

steps.title: Add Manual Samples
steps.instruction: Add any additional manually-prepared samples, including their master mix, to empty wells of your choosing on the qPCR plate.

steps.title: Execute Robot Script
steps.instruction: Run the script 'StationC-24-plus3-plus1-2020-04-09.py' on the robot.

steps.title: Clean Robot
steps.instruction: Clean the OT-2 robot according to the cleaning protocol for a COVID-19 Diagnostic Station.
